env.name: TBA_API_KEY
env.description: The Blue Alliance read API key (free: thebluealliance.com/account). Used for schedules, live scores and rankings. Without it the app falls back to Statbotics.

env.name: JEV_API_KEY
env.description: Jev key: either a Vercel AI Gateway key (starts with vck_) or a TypeSafe key. The app picks the right endpoint automatically. Leave blank to use only the statistical model.

env.name: JEV_WEIGHT
env.description: How much Jev's answer counts in the blended prediction, 0 to 1.

env.name: JEV_MODEL
env.description: Optional. Leave blank for the default (typesafe-ai/jev on AI Gateway, jev-latest on TypeSafe).

env.name: JEV_API_URL
env.description: Optional. Leave blank to pick automatically from the key type.
